metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS DNB monthly composites (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG as primary, fallback to VCMCFG). Compute annual mean avg_rad for 2012 and 2016 over a 15 km buffer around Aleppo city center (36.206, 37.158). 2. Masking strategy: Use inherent masking from composites; count valid pixels via reduceRegion. No explicit cloud masking needed (monthly cloud-free composites). 3. Logic: If either year’s collection is empty -> C1. If valid pixel count after compositing is 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise, compare 2016 mean < 2012 mean -> A; else B. const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { const getInfo = (eeObj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo((v, e) => e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))); const region = ee.Geometry.Point([37.158, 36.206]).buffer(15000); // Aleppo ~15 km buffer const primaryColId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'; const fallbackColId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG'; async function getYearStats(year) { const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1); const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year + 1, 1, 1); let col = ee.ImageCollection(primaryColId).filterDate(start, end).select(['avg_rad']); let n = await getInfo(col.size()); let usedColId = primaryColId; if (!n || n === 0) { const col2 = ee.ImageCollection(fallbackColId).filterDate(start, end).select(['avg_rad']); const n2 = await getInfo(col2.size()); if (!n2 || n2 === 0) { return { empty: true, usedColId: null, nImages: 0, mean: null, pixels: 0 }; } col = col2; n = n2; usedColId = fallbackColId; } const yearImg = col.mean().rename('avg_rad'); const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const dict = await getInfo(yearImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })); const mean = dict ? dict['avg_rad_mean'] : null; const pixels = dict ? dict['avg_rad_count'] : 0; return { empty: false, usedColId, nImages: n, mean, pixels }; } try { const stats2012 = await getYearStats(2012); const stats2016 = await getYearStats(2016); if (stats2012.empty || stats2016.empty) { console.log('Region: Aleppo (15 km buffer)'); console.log(`2012 Images: ${stats2012.nImages || 0}`); console.log(`2016 Images: ${stats2016.nImages || 0}`); console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).'); return; } if ((stats2012.pixels || 0) === 0 || (stats2016.pixels || 0) === 0) { console.log('Region: Aleppo (15 km buffer)'); console.log(`2012 Images: ${stats2012.nImages}, Pixels: ${stats2012.pixels || 0}`); console.log(`2016 Images: ${stats2016.nImages}, Pixels: ${stats2016.pixels || 0}`); console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).'); return; } const m2012 = stats2012.mean; const m2016 = stats2016.mean; if (m2012 === null || m2016 === null || !isFinite(m2012) || !isFinite(m2016)) { console.log('Region: Aleppo (15 km buffer)'); console.log(`2012 Images: ${stats2012.nImages}, Pixels: ${stats2012.pixels}, Mean_rad: ${m2012}`); console.log(`2016 Images: ${stats2016.nImages}, Pixels: ${stats2016.pixels}, Mean_rad: ${m2016}`); console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is `None`, `NaN`, or invalid).'); return; } const diff = m2016 - m2012; const pct = m2012 !== 0 ? (diff / m2012) * 100 : null; console.log(`Dataset: ${stats2012.usedColId}`); console.log(`2012 Images: ${stats2012.nImages}, Pixels: ${stats2012.pixels}, Mean_rad: ${m2012.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`2016 Images: ${stats2016.nImages}, Pixels: ${stats2016.pixels}, Mean_rad: ${m2016.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Change (2016-2012): ${diff.toFixed(2)}${pct === null ? '' : ` (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)`}`); if (m2016 < m2012) { console.log('A: Yes'); } else { console.log('B: No'); } } catch (err) { console.log('Error:', err && err.message ? err.message : err); console.log('D: If image, collection, or band names are incorrect, syntax or method error, wrong method, or memory issue, etc.'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE();
